The '''Hellwell''' was a mysterious, seemingly bottomless pit located in the [[Moridebo district|Moridebo District]] of [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]]. Originally created by a mining conglomerate as a disposal pit, it eventually became a dumping ground for criminals wishing to dispose of troublesome beings.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
